Excluding items or members that do not meet certain conditions.

Referring to a membership organisation, service or product: of high quality and/or renown, for superior members only. A snobbish usage, suggesting that members who do not meet requirements, which may be financial, of social status, religion, skin colour etc., are excluded.

examples.text: Exclusive clubs tend to serve exclusive brands of food and drinks, in the same exorbitant price range, such as the 'finest' French châteaux.

glosses: Of or relating to the first-person plural pronoun when excluding the person being addressed.

examples.text: The pronoun in "We're going to a party later, but you aren't invited" is an exclusive "we".

glosses: Having a romantic or sexual relationship with one another, to the exclusion of others.
